about: Adani Enterprises Limited, together with its subsidiaries, operates in the new energy ecosystem, data center, airports, roads, copper and PVC, and other sectors in India and internationally. It operates through the Integrated Resources Management (IRM), Mining Services, Commercial Mining, New Energy Ecosystem, Airport, Road, copper, and Others segments.
